answer_verbatim:
If you want to check whether **AI answer engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business**, the best *starting point* is a **free AI visibility diagnostic** such as **HubSpot AI Search Grader** or a similar baseline checker, because it quickly shows whether your brand appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity without requiring a big commitment.[6][15]

If you want the **best ongoing paid service** for most small businesses, the strongest budget-friendly options in the results are **Otterly.AI** and **Semrush AI Visibility**, with Otterly.AI aimed at lightweight monitoring and Semrush better if you already use Semrush and want broader SEO/AI workflow integration.[6][15]

For **local businesses specifically**, the results point to **AI Rank Checker** as a strong fit because it emphasizes real-time local query checks across major AI platforms and local optimization diagnostics.[14]

A practical way to choose:
- **Free baseline first:** use a free diagnostic to see what AI systems say about you now.[6][15]
- **Want simple monitoring:** choose **Otterly.AI**.[6][15]
- **Already use Semrush:** choose **Semrush AI Visibility**.[2][6][15]
- **Mostly local customers:** choose **AI Rank Checker**.[14]
- **Want a “who recommends me and why” view:** **OwlSearch AI** is positioned around exactly that use case.[3]

If you want, I can narrow this to the **single best tool for your budget** and whether your business is **local, ecommerce, or service-based**.
